description: This file defines the Configuration class within the SuiteCRM�Utility namespace. It manages configuration settings by implementing ArrayAccess, loading configuration data from an external Configurator class, and providing methods to get, set, check, and unset configuration options.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class that manages configuration settings, allowing array-like access to configuration options, loaded from an external Configurator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object by loading configuration data from the Configurator class.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a configuration value at a specified offset, throws exception if offset is null or not found.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration offset exists.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified offset, returns null if not set.
